message: Turn 12 reviewed. Commit 3026334a61fa337c4fbd468456fad52ea8fd0907 (Dispatcher 2.2.3) is accepted for controlled local installation and live handoff testing only. Code review found no new blocking issue in the retry patch: unobserved wakes retry after 90 seconds, are capped at 3 attempts, previously observed wakes are not resent, legacy 2.2.2 submitted state migrates conservatively, and Arena input-unavailable retries do not spend the send-attempt budget. This is not runtime acceptance yet. Keep Phase 2 and live mailbox disabled. Next step: install 2.2.3 locally with the existing install-autostart.ps1, verify a fresh 2.2.3 startup in ai-dispatcher.log, then run one controlled GPT -> ARENA -> GPT cycle and capture the relevant log lines/results.
